senses.gloss: (cmp. פָּלַשׁ I) to split, pick to pieces.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 19b:17">B. Kam. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא חמרא … ופַלְסֵיה לסלא</he> an ass ate (a neighbor’s) bread and picked the basket to pieces.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 19b:17">Ib.</cite> <he>אכיל והדר פָּלֵיס</he> he eats first and then picks to pieces.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="Q01098">same</cite>. Ib. <he>אורחיה נמי לפַלּוּסֵי סלא</he> it is also his habit to demolish a basket.
